schema.description: Request body for updating a Company. Only the fields passed change.

joinCode.description: A unique 6-character code that can be used to join or reference this Company. Another Company with the same code answers 409.

referenceId.description: The ID of the Company in your own system. Null removes it. Another Company with the same reference answers 409.

schema.title: UpdateCompanyRequest

Reference.summary: Link a company to your own company ID
